title: [No application window] mRemoteNG 1.81.0-beta.3 NB 3410
author: vndnua
body_snippet:
Perhaps I am doing something wrong:
I checked on three different computers: mRemoteNG.exe starts (I can see it in the task manager processes, CPU usage = 0), but the application window does not appear.

The folder “C:\Users\user\AppData\Local\mRemoteNG Connection Manager” is not created.

The folder “C:\Users\user\AppData\Roaming\mRemoteNG Connection Manager” is created, with the following files in a subfolder:
C:\Users\user\AppData\Roaming\mRemoteNG Connection Manager\Themes\darcula.vstheme
C:\...

iterations.action: Root cause: Startup.cs field initializer `_frmMain = FrmMain.Default` triggers FrmMain creation before Application.SetHighDpiMode/EnableVisualStyles/SetCompatibleTextRenderingDefault. Caused by new `Startup.Instance.CommandLineArgs = args;` in MainAsync accessing Startup singleton too early. Fix: remove unused _frmMain field.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
## Root Cause Found

The issue is a regression in v1.81.0-beta.3 caused by premature `FrmMain` creation.

### What happened

In `Startup.cs`, there was an unused field:
```csharp
private readonly FrmMain _frmMain = FrmMain.Default;
```

This field initializer runs when `Startup.Instance` is first accessed. In beta.3, a new line was added to `ProgramRoot.MainAsync()`:
```csharp
Startup.Instance.CommandLineArgs = args;  // Accesses Startup singleton early
```
